label: Fox
idea: A wedge-shaped fox with a sideways glance, black ear tips, torn cheek fur, and a smile cut out of its muzzle.
smallNote: The ear triangles and long white muzzle stay; cheek hatching disappears.

label: Octopus
idea: A bulbous, unimpressed octopus unwinds eight chunky arms. Tiny suckers and a curled lower arm give it the feel of a rubber-hose cartoon.
smallNote: Eight blunt arm endings, a domed head, and two white eye cuts replace the fine suckers.

label: Panda
idea: A panda with oversized vinyl-black ears and mismatched eye patches. One raised brow, one low lid, and a crooked grin break the symmetry.
smallNote: Round ears and diagonal black eye patches carry the identity without fur marks.

label: Penguin
idea: A leaning penguin in an ink-black tuxedo, with flared flippers, big boots, and an off-centre white shirt-front.
smallNote: The upright black body, white bib, beak, and two wide feet remain.

label: Owl
idea: A compact owl built from two enormous, unequal eye discs, horn-like feather tufts, and a dense black wing. Its claws curl around a little branch.
smallNote: Two open eye discs dominate a pointed, tapering body.

label: Turtle
idea: A low, domed turtle with an architectural shell, a stretchy curious neck, and blunt little feet. The shell is built from bold, irregular panels.
smallNote: The domed shell and long side-facing neck survive; the panel map becomes three large cells.

label: Lion
idea: A cut-paper sunburst mane surrounds a long-nosed lion. Muzzle lobes, a theatrical chin, and cut-back eyes give the face a vintage mascot rhythm.
smallNote: A scalloped ink mane frames a white muzzle and broad triangular nose.

label: Tiger
idea: A broad-cheeked tiger with fierce graphic stripes and a cheerful toothy muzzle. The forehead stripes are chunky ink wedges, not fine fur texture.
smallNote: Four decisive stripes and a split white muzzle separate it from the lion and bear.

label: Koala
idea: Huge ragged ears, a drooping pill-shaped nose, and a sleepy side glance. The soft exterior meets hard patches of black fur.
smallNote: The ears and long black nose occupy most of the small master.

label: Frog
idea: A gloriously wide frog with pop-up eye towers and an almost ridiculous crescent grin. Warty dots sit against one deep black mouth.
smallNote: Two eye bumps and the wide mouth are kept oversized at 16px.

label: Unicorn
idea: A proud side-profile unicorn with a striped horn, swept ink mane, high collar-like jaw, and one half-lidded eye.
smallNote: Profile, diagonal horn, and the deep mane do the work; stripe and eyelash detail is removed.

label: Bee
idea: A striped bean of a bee, buzzing on mismatched wings with a sharp sting and little hooked feet. Oversized eyes lean into its flying direction.
smallNote: Two broad wing lobes, two body bands, and one eye replace the wing veins and feet.

label: Spouting whale
idea: A smiling whale throws a three-way fountain while its raised flukes curl over the body. Long belly grooves and a little fin give the big shape movement.
smallNote: A blunt head, raised tail, and three thick fountain strokes remain.

label: Butterfly
idea: An uneven pair of wings mixes big black tips, paper teardrops, and eyespot-like ovals. The tiny body sports high antennae and a cocked head.
smallNote: Four clearly separated wing lobes and two large paper spots replace the fine wing pattern.

label: Bear
idea: A broad, inky bear with small round ears, a protruding paper muzzle, and one eyebrow raised. Short fur incisions keep the black mass lively.
smallNote: The dark head and large white muzzle distinguish it from the light panda.

label: Rabbit
idea: A rabbit whose mismatched ears act like bent aerials. An oversized tooth, diagonal whiskers, and a cheeky side-eye make it feel drawn in ink.
smallNote: Tall ears, round cheeks, and a single big tooth stay distinct from the small-eared animals.

label: Hedgehog
idea: A scruffy wedge of spines gives way to a long pointed nose and tiny planted feet. Three ranks of cut-paper quills make the back feel wonderfully overbuilt.
smallNote: Five big spines and a long snout replace the layered quill texture.

label: Parrot
idea: A crested parrot perches in profile, with a giant hooked beak, a graphic cheek patch, and an extravagant striped tail.
smallNote: The hook of the beak and long diagonal tail are the main reading cues.

label: Lady beetle
idea: A tilted lady beetle becomes a glossy little print-shop stamp: broad black spots, one divided shell, six bent legs, and a tiny inquisitive head.
smallNote: Four enlarged dots and a central shell seam replace the smaller markings.

label: Flamingo
idea: A long S-neck flamingo balances on one leg, with a drooping two-tone beak and a folded wing shaped like a brushstroke.
smallNote: The hooked neck, long planted leg, and folded knee retain the unmistakable silhouette.

label: Dolphin
idea: A dolphin curls into a leaping comma. Its long beak, swept dorsal fin, underbelly, and split flukes remain clear inside a bold black silhouette.
smallNote: The small drawing exaggerates beak, dorsal fin, and forked tail.

label: T. rex
idea: A heavy-jawed dinosaur with a checkerboard grin, tiny reaching arms, a big belly, and an impatient tail. It is all attitude and mismatched proportions.
smallNote: An oversized jaw, sawtooth mouth, short arm, and sweeping tail define the little master.

label: Wolf
idea: A narrow, upward-tilted wolf head with tall black ears, a long muzzle, and stepped neck fur. The profile separates it from the front-facing fox.
smallNote: A tall ear and rising snout stay angular; the neck ends in three large fur points.

label: Raccoon
idea: A ragged, wide raccoon face peers through one sweeping black mask. Little pointed ears, white brows, and a dark chin make a very different character from the panda.
smallNote: A continuous eye mask and white pointed muzzle carry the small version.

label: Otter
idea: A floating otter holds a little stone on its chest, with its feet tilted toward the viewer and its heavy tail curled underneath. A soft muzzle and whiskers keep it otter-like.
smallNote: The reclined body, two feet, and held pebble remain; water and whisker lines are omitted.

label: Snail
idea: A low-slung snail drags a huge spiral shell, with two stalked eyes, a folded underside, and a smiling shovel-shaped face.
smallNote: A large spiral and two high eye stalks survive without the shell hatching.

label: Crab
idea: A squat crab wears its giant claws like boxing gloves. Eight angular leg endings, stalked eyes, and a toothed grin give it a dense, comic silhouette.
smallNote: Two huge open pincers and a low shell replace the finer limb articulation.

label: Blowfish
idea: A puffed-up spiky globe with a tiny tail, enormous suspicious eyes, and a puckered mouth. Solid fins interrupt the sunburst outline.
smallNote: Eight broad spikes, a side tail, and a ring-shaped mouth stay readable.

label: Seal
idea: A whiskered seal props itself up on one paddle while its body flows into a split rear flipper. Long whiskers and a plump white belly keep the form gentle.
smallNote: A round head joins a low body and double flipper; three muzzle marks replace the whiskers.

label: Chipmunk
idea: A striped chipmunk curls a huge comma tail around an acorn. Small ears, puffed cheeks, a white racing stripe, and a bent hind foot keep the subject specific.
smallNote: The curling tail, cheek, and held nut remain; three back stripes reduce to one white slash.

label: Ewe
idea: A cloud of uneven wool sits on four ink-black sticks, with a dark drooping face and tiny pointed ears. Spiral curls add a little 1970s print texture.
smallNote: A white scalloped body, dark head, and four strong feet replace the curls.

label: Elephant
idea: A broad-eared elephant in three-quarter view with a curled trunk, two tiny tusks, and comic forehead wrinkles. The trunk doubles back like a loose cable.
smallNote: The giant ears and looping trunk take priority over tusks and creases.

label: Giraffe
idea: A tall giraffe bust with little knobbed horns, wide leaf ears, a long slanted neck, and irregular ink patches. Its muzzle is intentionally oversized.
smallNote: Knobbed horns, the long neck, and three large spots replace the fine spots and mane.

label: Zebra
idea: A zebra with a stepped punk mane and a long, blunt muzzle. Broad wedges of black stripe bend around the face and long neck.
smallNote: The small master retains three heavy stripes, the mane, and squared muzzle.

label: Two-hump camel
idea: A two-humped camel ambles on long bent legs. Its bored face, lumpy humps, and heavy underside make it feel like a character on an old travel decal.
smallNote: Two separate hump peaks, a high neck, and four long feet are essential.

label: Sloth
idea: A sloth hangs sideways from a crooked branch, with very long hook arms and two dark eye crescents. Its smile is a small interruption in an otherwise lazy pose.
smallNote: The hanging hook, dark eye patches, and tucked body remain; three-claw detail disappears.

label: Cactus
idea: A three-armed cactus in a striped nursery pot, with tiny ink thorns and low-lidded eyes. Its ribs feel like grooves in a vintage plastic toy.
smallNote: Three rising arms and a trapezoid pot remain; ribs reduce to one incision.

label: Mushroom
idea: A low mushroom cap becomes a checker-spotted umbrella over a stout, eye-bearing stem. A dark gill band gives the cap a strong underside.
smallNote: The umbrella silhouette, three large cap spots, and chunky stem carry the drawing.

label: Sunflower
idea: A heavy, seed-speckled face sits inside a ring of slightly wonky petals. The stalk bends under two bold leaves, like a mascot from a 1970s seed packet.
smallNote: Eight blunt petals surround an ink disc; the two leaves stay broad.

label: Lemon
idea: A bumpy, sharply pointed lemon with a leafy quiff and a deeply unimpressed expression. Pith-like hatching gives the rind a printed texture.
smallNote: Two pointed ends, one leaf, and one arched eye cut remain.

label: Watermelon
idea: A slanted watermelon wedge wears heavy-rimmed sunglasses. Fat seed teardrops, a generous rind, and a chipped point make it a sticker with a strong triangular read.
smallNote: The wedge and two thick rind arcs stay; sunglasses merge into one black band.

label: Avocado
idea: A pear-shaped avocado carries a giant pit with a little face inside. A thick rind, one leaf, and subtle off-centre contours make the image feel carved.
smallNote: The pear silhouette and a large round pit stay; the pit face becomes two white dots.

label: Doughnut
idea: A hefty doughnut with loose dripping icing, crooked sprinkles, and a big central hole. An eye pair above the hole turns the whole ring into a startled face.
smallNote: A big paper centre and broad icing drips replace the sprinkles.

label: Rocket
idea: A riveted, checker-finned rocket tilts into flight. Its porthole becomes an eye, its exhaust a stack of ink-and-paper flames, and its panels feel like old toy metal.
smallNote: The diagonal body, porthole, paired fins, and bold flame form the small version.

label: Balloon
idea: A single pear-shaped balloon with a defiant face, thick highlight, tied neck, and a long unruly string. The line has the spring of old cartoon motion.
smallNote: The tied neck and kinked string remain; a pair of big eye cuts replaces the expression.

label: Ringed planet
idea: A tilted ringed planet with a heavy orbit band, zonal ink stripes, sleepy eyes, and a few four-point stars. It feels like a decal from a fictional record shop.
smallNote: A single clean orbital band crosses the disc; two planetary stripes remain.

label: Crescent moon
idea: A long-nosed crescent moon nods off in profile, with a protruding nose, small grin, crater dots, and stars cut like printer ornaments.
smallNote: A bold crescent with a face notch and one star remains.

label: Test tube
idea: A tilted laboratory tube bubbles over with an eye-bearing potion. Measurement cuts, a thick glass lip, and blunt liquid bubbles make it a playful bit of bench equipment.
smallNote: The diagonal glass tube, dark liquid fill, and one floating bubble remain.
